results.objective: Backend returns a controlled error when the analytics service is down and recovers after restart without false success
results.preconditions: Analysis UPLOADED; local analytics container stopped (failure injection on dev stack)
results.steps: docker compose stop analytics; POST validate; GET analysis; docker compose start analytics; wait /health; POST validate
results.expected: 5xx with error code ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE; status stays UPLOADED; after restart validate returns 200
results.actual: during outage HTTP 503 code=ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE msg='The analytics service is unavailable.'; status after=UPLOADED; healthy after restart=True; retry HTTP 200
